root_cause: Supabase CLI 2.119.0 renders migration-list version cells with surrounding backticks while the trusted repair parser accepted only bare fourteen-digit values, causing valid rows to be discarded before any production mutation.
prevention_rule: Normalize only presentation delimiters before exact migration identity comparison; retain the exact four-version allowlist, forbid remote-only drift, and require zero post-repair drift.
finding: Trusted-main OIDC and IPv4 Supavisor transport were healthy; the repair stopped because migration-list rendering was parsed too narrowly.
structural_fix: strip surrounding backticks and whitespace from local/remote migration-list cells
apply identical normalization to pre-repair and post-repair readback
keep exact version comparison and official migration repair semantics unchanged
